outputs.explanation: Panel A is a bar-style illustration showing single percentage values (illumination overhead) for each exposure time condition, not an average across replicates, so no individual data points are required.
Line plot of photobleaching decay curves with shaded mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Scatter/XY plot of ΔROS vs exposure time with error bars; scatter plots are exempt since the plotted points themselves are the data.
Line plots of individual cell migration tracks; each line already represents a single migrating cell, and line plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Bar chart of mean migration speed has individual cell data points (dots) overlaid on each bar.
Panel F consists of micrograph images (Mitotracker/Paxillin/merge), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G shows a time-lapse micrograph series, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel H shows a time-lapse micrograph series, not a plot of averaged data.
Line plot of normalized cell area over time with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time with mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
